issues.explanation: No test exercises the unique (entity_id, user_id) constraint or duplicate slug rejection, though both are explicit task requirements.
SoftDeletes on Entity and UserRole::manageable() are in the contract but have no test coverage.
Feature test file named EntityModelTest also contains all EntityPolicy and EntityMembershipPolicy assertions, which would be clearer in a dedicated policy test file.

conventions.evidence: database/migrations/2026_10_29_000000_create_entities_table.php:477-480 and 2026_10_29_000001_create_entity_memberships_table.php:531-534 reversible down(); #[Fillable] in app/Models/Entity.php:38 and app/Models/EntityMembership.php:97 matches app/Models/User.php sibling; authorization in app/Policies/; docs/database-schema.md:597-599 plus CHANGELOG.md:9 updated in same change

readability.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:55-77 small focused memberships/users/owner relations; app/Models/User.php:195 membershipFor(int $entityId): ?EntityMembership; no dead code or debug output

requirements.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:48 getRouteKeyName returns 'slug'; database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_entity_memberships_table.php:510-524 storedAs \"CASE WHEN role = 'owner' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END\" plus unique entity_memberships_one_owner; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:303-337 create/view/update/delete/manageSettings; app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:247-274 view/assignRole/delete with owner never-deletable plus self-removal

scope.evidence: diff only adds Entity/EntityMembership/UserRole, two migrations, two factories, two policies, EntityModelTest and required docs (CHANGELOG.md, docs/database-schema.md); no routes, pages, session handling or Livewire per out-of-scope

security.evidence: app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:312 view requires membershipFor !== null; app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:266-268 owner role delete returns false; app/Models/EntityMembership.php:97-98 #[Fillable] without owner_seq plus #[Hidden(['owner_seq'])]; no Blade output or Livewire surface

simplicity.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:55-77 reuses HasMany/BelongsToMany/HasOne with withPivot/withTimestamps; memberships migration enforces one-owner with one storedAs column plus unique index, no triggers or services

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:667-672 second owner throws QueryException; tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:694-741 policy matrix for entity create/view/update/delete/manageSettings and membership view/assignRole/delete; gaps: no duplicate entity_user/slug, SoftDeletes, or manageable() test

review.summary: Change implements the full entity/membership data model, portable one-owner database constraint, factories and both policies exactly per contract, with docs updated and a meaningful Pest suite. Tests miss only minor cases (duplicate membership/slug, soft deletes, manageable), so the pull request is approvable with nits.
